Good morning, welcome to VoiceoverGuy.co.uk!

Guy Harris – British Male Voiceover Artist

“You may not know my name, but you've definitely heard my voice...
On the radio, TV, apps, video games, or even live events, my voice connects brands with audiences worldwide.”

Your Trusted British Male Voiceover Artist

Need a British male voiceover that hits the mark every time?
over two decades of experience and more than 200,000 scripts recorded, I’ve voiced for top global brands including Apple, Disney, ITV and the BBC. Warm, natural narration to high-energy character reads for commercials, explainer videos, eLearning, games, and more.
As a multi-award-winning UK voiceover artist, clients come to me for quality, speed, and reliability. I deliver broadcast-ready audio from my pro studio, fast turnaround, easy communication, no drama. Let’s bring your script to life.


Guy Harris – Professional Voiceover Artist



Versatile Voiceovers for Every Brief

From TV commercials and narration to animation, live events, and game trailers, I deliver voiceovers tailored to each unique project. I’ve voiced Salty in Thomas & Friends, narrated documentaries, and served as the Voice of God for global events like the International Gaming Awards.

Need something natural and sincere? Or a bold character voice that steals the show? Whether you’re after friendly, formal, funny or full-blown drama, I’ve got it covered.

As a seasoned British male voiceover artist, I’ve adapted my delivery across countless industries – tech, retail, entertainment, education, finance, always keeping the end result crisp, compelling, and bang on brief. I'm happy with thousands of words too.


Versatile Voiceover – Guy Harris



Professional Studio for Broadcast-Quality Audio

Based in West Yorkshire, I record from a fully equipped, state-of-the-art voiceover studio used daily by clients worldwide. Featuring premium microphones like the Neumann U87 and MKH 416, plus Source Connect and Cleanfeed for remote sessions, my setup guarantees exceptional sound quality.
With 24-hour turnaround on most projects, you’ll get your audio fast and polished. TV, radio, or digital platforms, my professional recording studio ensures broadcast-quality results every time.


Professional Voiceover Studio – Guy Harris


The Voice Behind Big Brands – Trusted, Booked, Proven

From global names like Samsung and Booking.com to national staples like the BBC, ITV, and Heart Radio, brands trust me to bring their message to life. I’ve added cheeky charm to In for a Penny on ITV, brought festive sparkle as Santa on Capital Radio, and delivered clear, friendly narration for Alton Towers’ safety announcements.


Each project, big or small, receives the same level of professionalism and polish. When it matters most, clients know they can count on me to deliver voiceovers that are memorable, engaging, and right on brief.


The Voice Behind Big Brands – Guy Harris on Stage

Bringing Characters to Life

Need a voice that adds real character? From Salty and Winston in Thomas & Friends to Dracula at Paultons Park, I bring distinctive character voices to animation and theme parks. My characters bring warmth, humour, and unmistakable personality to every project.
Trusted for my David Attenborough impression, used in films and promos, I voice characters for shows, events and radio ads and I voice goblins in Clash of Clans. My animation voiceover work spans gaming, cartoons, and branded storytelling, combining creativity with precision to craft unforgettable characters. I also bring that same energy to my football commentator voice, heard on BBC and Netflix.


Character Voices – Guy Harris


The UK’s No.1 Voice of Santa

It’s not Christmas without the Voice of Santa! As the go-to Santa for BBC, ITV, Heart Radio, and even Tesco, I’ve brought the magic of Christmas to life for years. From live broadcasts and national campaigns to personalised films and festive events, my Santa voice is trusted by top brands to spread joy and cheer.
I also run Santa Radio — the world’s biggest online Christmas station, broadcasting festive favourites 365 days a year.
You might’ve heard me in campaigns for Butlins, ITV’s In for a Penny, and Paultons Park. A familiar festive voice across the UK. If your project needs an authentic, joyful Santa voice that captivates audiences, I can create the perfect Christmas atmosphere.


Guy Harris – UK Voice of Santa
